RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is weak evidence on its own — it often reflects who already holds senior posts rather than bias in this decision. Don't lead with it; as a standalone claim it looks speculative and invites dismissal.

Your stronger material is concrete: a PhD versus a master's, eight years actually running a section versus an undefined "broad leadership experience," and an unanswered two-week-old request for written reasons. Chase that documentation first, in writing, citing your right to the panel's criteria and scoring.

If the reasons come back vague, or weight unmeasured "leadership" over your documented record, panel composition becomes relevant context — part of a pattern, not the accusation itself.
